prospects.notes_preview: Commercial painter, wallcoverings + resinous flooring. SIBA-AGC member. Owns tooncopainting.com. RE-VERIFIED 2026-08-24 in Chrome: the domain is BACK to a parked lander - apex 302s to /lander and the DOM renders a single class='parked-content' node on a blank dark page, no business content, no ad tiles. (08-19 parked, 08-23 error page, 08-24 parked again - this domain flip-flops, load it right before you dial.) DNS healthy at GoDaddy; MX live on Microsoft 365 + FortiMail. He pays for business email on a domain that shows visitors a blank parking page. Owner/President Eric Toon.
prospects.ai_hook: Ask for Eric Toon, owner/president. LEAD WITH THE SPLIT: his email works, his website doesn't. Say: 'Eric, you're bidding commercial work off eric@tooncopainting.com - that's Microsoft 365, you pay for it. But when a GC types tooncopainting.com into a browser, nothing of yours comes up.' *** LOAD tooncopainting.com YOURSELF RIGHT BEFORE YOU DIAL. *** It has flip-flopped three times: parked lander 08-19, dead error page 08-23, parked lander again 08-24. As of 2026-08-24 it serves a BLANK PARKING PAGE, so say 'it loads a blank parking page' - and if it errors when you check, say 'it errors out' instead. Do not commit to either wording sight-unseen; being wrong burns the first ten seconds. Safe wording that works either way: 'there's nothing of yours on it.' Proof points if he pushes back: SIBA-AGC member, Staunton High School renovation, Lewis & Clark Confluence Tower. MOCKUP LINK: the 2026-08-23 note claiming urbanbackstage.com sits behind Cloudflare Access did NOT hold up on 2026-08-24 - /demo/ mockup pages returned HTTP 200 with no Access prompt, and per the hosting truth map backstage is GitHub Pages with no Cloudflare in the page path at all. Before you send the link to a prospect the first time, open it once on your phone with wifi off to be certain.

Ask for Wayne Konfrst, he's the owner. Lead with the licence most tree companies don't have: they carry a PESTICIDE-APPLICATION licence and licensed-arborist status on top of removal, which means they can diagnose and TREAT a sick tree instead of only cutting it down. Say: 'you can save a tree, not just take it down, and there's nowhere online that says so.' Credibility: 25 years, Iowa registration C127115 active as Wayne Konfrst Enterprises LLC, 4.6 stars over 8 reviews, commercial and residential, and a dedicated business manager on staff. The no-website line is specific: konfrsttreeservice.com does not resolve at all, and their BBB listing sends people to a Facebook page instead of a site. Nothing sensitive on this one - clean file.

Ask for Joe Breon, he's the owner. Lead with the geography: he runs TWO Iowa shops about 250 miles apart - Sheldon in the northwest corner and Boone in the middle of the state - off one phone number and no website. Say: 'you're covering two ends of Iowa and there's no page telling either market you're in it.' Ask which market he'd rather grow; that question does the qualifying for you. Credibility: 32 years since August 1994, roofing, siding AND seamless gutters, Iowa registration C136643 active, BuildZoom score 92 which is the top third of nearly 40,000 Iowa contractors. WATCH OUT: three different numbers exist for him - BBB 515-203-7623 is the one on the card, but Buzzfile lists 515-337-1022 and the Boone shop is 515-236-4305. Also 515 is a central-Iowa code and Sheldon is 712 territory, so confirm you have the right Joe Breon when he picks up.

Ask for Bryan Woody, he's the owner. Lead with the corridor: he works out of a rural address on 290th Street in West Branch but pulls reviews from the whole Iowa City to Cedar Rapids corridor, competing against corridor HVAC firms that all outrank him online while he has 27 years on them. Say: 'you've got more time in than the guys beating you on Google, and they're beating you on Google.' Credibility: in business since 1999, BBB A+, 4.32 stars over 12 reviews, and he does full replacements and remodel ductwork rather than only service calls - that matters because replacement is the high-ticket job the website would actually win. woodysheatingandair.com does not resolve. Secondary number if the first doesn't answer: 319-430-2743. Nothing sensitive on this one.

Ask for Robert Poss, he's the owner. THIS IS THE BEST HOOK IN THE BATCH. He OWNS posspainting.com and it is PARKED - loading it redirects to a lander page showing generic ad tiles reading 'Poss Painting Company', 'Poss Painting Meaning', 'Poss Painting Ideas'. Say: 'Robert, you own posspainting.com. Right now it's a parking page selling ads to whoever lands on it - and some of those ads are your competitors.' That is verified live, not a guess. Back it with heritage: founded 1954, seventy-two years, three generations in the Milwaukee metro, two Muskego locations, LLC formalised in 2005. Say: 'seventy-two years and the only thing at your own address is an ad farm.' DO NOT assume how busy they are - there is zero review volume anywhere to corroborate current activity, so ask whether they're still actively bidding rather than asserting it.

Ask for Benjamin Hines, he's the owner. Lead with the scope nobody advertises: they do flashing systems, caulking and building-envelope WATERPROOFING alongside brick and tuckpointing. That is commercial property-manager work - a different and higher-margin buyer than the homeowner brick jobs they're currently visible for. Say: 'you're set up to sell to property managers and the only thing findable is homeowner brickwork.' Credibility: 5.0 on Angi, commercial and residential, 20-plus years combined crew experience. easterniowamasonry.com does not resolve. CAUTION - this is the thinnest paper trail in the batch: BBB lists no entity type and no business-start date, and no Iowa licence record was located. Do NOT assert how long the COMPANY has existed - the 20-plus years is combined crew experience, not company age. Ask.

prospects.notes_preview: | NAMESAKE WARNING: topqualityroofingco.com is a live site for an UNRELATED Top Quality Roofing LLC in Florida (407 numbers). Robert's Mount Zion IL company still has no website of its own - verified in Chrome 2026-08-21.
prospects.ai_hook: Already built Robert a free working homepage for Top Quality Roofing - lead with the mockup. CAREFUL: topqualityroofingco.com is live but it is a FLORIDA company with the same name, not his. If he says 'I think we have a website', that is what he is seeing. His Mount Zion company has none.

Ask for Gerald Sipes, or Corey Ingles who is the main contact on their AGC listing. Lead with the placeholder: gmsipes.com resolves but the homepage literally says UNDER CONSTRUCTION - just a logo and a 2026 copyright line, no services, no contact, nothing. Say: 'your domain is up and it's been saying Under Construction with a 2026 copyright on it. That's worse than having nothing, because people who look you up think you went under.' Verified live in a browser; a raw fetch would have read it as a working site. Credibility is the strongest in this batch: FMCSA USDOT 2015080 active with FIVE power units and SIX drivers, zero reportable crashes, named contractor on multiple IDOT patching awards, AGC of Illinois member since 2021, and they run their own barricades and traffic control rather than subbing it out. Say: 'six drivers on IDOT contracts statewide and a homepage that says Under Construction.' Nothing sensitive on this one.

Ask for Nate Cover, he's the president. Lead with the warranty nobody knows about: they're a NECA '+Five' contractor, which means they back new-home wiring with an ADDITIONAL five-year warranty. That is a written differentiator almost no electrician has and there is not one page anywhere that says so. Say: 'you back your work five years in writing and there's no place a customer can read that.' Credibility: in business since 1970 - fifty-six years - IBEW Local 34 signatory AND a NECA member contractor, commercial and industrial. The no-website evidence is the strongest of the batch, three independent signals: BBB renders no website button, the IBEW Local 34 directory prints a URL for about 35 of 45 signatory contractors and prints none for Cover, and coverelectric.com redirects to a parked lander page - they own it and it's parked. DO NOT quote the Manta revenue estimate back to him, it is modelled data not reported.

Ask for Michael Breckenkamp, he's the owner. Lead with the trade almost nobody still carries: veneer plastering and traditional plaster, alongside commercial drywall and EIFS. He's listed on Bluebook and Procore across SEVEN CSI divisions - gypsum board, plaster, EIFS, veneer plastering, wall finishes. Say: 'a GC looking for a plaster sub in west-central Illinois has almost nobody to call, and you're invisible to the ones searching.' Credibility: union IUPAT shop and a Painters District Council 58 signatory, BBB A+ with the file open since 2012, in business since 2010. breckenkamppainting.com does not resolve. Two things to note: he's registered as a sole proprietorship despite the 'Inc' in the trading name, and there's an address conflict - BBB says 3820 Stonegate Rd, Yelp says 5410 S 24th St, so confirm rather than reading one back to him.

Ask for Amy Cranford, she's the owner. LEAD WITH THE NAMESAKE PROBLEM: cranfordplumbing.com is a live, working plumbing website - but it belongs to a company in Cranford, NEW JERSEY, phone 908-272-4641. Say: 'Amy, if somebody searches Cranford Plumbing they can land on a plumber in New Jersey. Not you.' Verified live in a browser. DO NOT accuse her of having a website - that site is not hers, and cranfordplumbinginc.com is dead. Then stack the credibility, because it is genuinely deep: incorporated June 1977, forty-nine years, BBB ACCREDITED since 2015 with an A+, UA Plumbers Local 63 signatory, MIMCA member, certified WBE, and she runs Cranford Trenching & Backhoe as a second DBA so the excavation is in-house. Say: 'you're the only one who can dig it and plumb it, and nobody can find that out.' CAUTION: BBB lists only 3 employees, so ask about crew size rather than assuming. Alt number if needed: 309-697-3484.

Ask for Rick Primmer, he's the owner. LEAD WITH THE NAMESAKE PROBLEM - it is the whole call. Say: 'Rick, if somebody Googles Primmer Roofing right now they land on primmerroofing.com, and that is a roofing company in Tampa, Florida - area code 813. Not you.' That is verified live: primmerroofing.com is a real live site belonging to an unrelated Florida company, and rdprimmerroofing.com does not resolve at all. Every search for his own name sends work to somebody else's phone. Back it with the fix-it story: after the derecho a Cedar Rapids commercial addition leaked from day one, other contractors could not find the source, and Rick was brought in as the repair contractor and found it - it is written into permit PB20-1129, 44 squares shingle plus 35 squares TPO. Say: 'you're the guy they call when the first roofer fails, and the only place that story exists is a city permit record.' Credibility: Iowa registration C138098 active, bonded $25,000, BBB A+, four reviews all five stars, zero complaints, 40-plus years on flat roofs. DO NOT assume crew size - BuildZoom lists only Rick, so ask how many trucks he runs rather than assuming. DO NOT accuse him of having a website - primmerroofing.com is NOT his.

Ask for Mike Landgrebe, he's the president. Lead with Old State Capitol Plaza: the Office of the Illinois State Treasurer signed a SOLE-SOURCE contracting and general facility repair agreement with him on 2021-10-04 for the Marine Bank Building at One East Old State Capitol Plaza - $93.00/hr basic and $96.00/hr foreman straight time, written to the Illinois Prevailing Wage Act. Say: 'the State of Illinois picked one contractor to keep a building on Old State Capitol Plaza standing, and there is not one page on the internet where that fact lives.' The no-website line is checkable and specific: his own staff email domain, landgrebeconstruction.com, is mail-only - it was loaded in a browser twice, on 2026-08-11 and again on 2026-08-18, and returns a browser error page both times. The CIB AGC directory literally prints 'http://NULL' where his website should be. Credibility: incorporated in Illinois 12-05-1991, doing ceiling work since 1988, IL SOS file 56630996 ACTIVE, three named office staff including a dedicated PM/estimator, CIB AGC and Springfield Chamber member. DO NOT mention BBB - Not Rated and not accredited, there is no reputation pitch here. DO NOT say the Treasurer went sole-source because the public bid drew zero responses - true, but it lands as an insult. NOTE FOR RICKY: this record was created 2026-08-11 but its mockup was never actually built until 2026-08-18, so despite the older create date he has NEVER been contacted. Treat as a first touch.

Ask for John Sheehan, he's the owner - he is both the principal and the customer contact, so he answers. Lead with the split audience: he has been in The Blue Book of Building and Construction since 2016, which is the directory general contractors flip through to source a mason - so GCs across Milwaukee, Waukesha and Washington County can find him, but a homeowner Googling 'tuckpointing West Allis' cannot find him at all. Say: 'the contractors can find you in a book. The homeowners can't find you anywhere.' The no-website line is airtight: johnsheehanconstruction.com and sheehanconstruction.com were both loaded in a browser on 2026-08-18 and both return error pages, and his BBB profile renders no website button at all. Credibility: started 1 May 1991 - thirty-five years - BBB A+, accredited since 2018, zero complaints, three counties. DO NOT bring up his review count - he has ZERO BBB customer reviews after 35 years and it is a sore spot, not a hook. DO NOT frame the permit thing as a problem - BBB notes he does not pull residential permits, that is normal for a sub. DO NOT assume crew size - sole proprietorship, so ask how many guys he runs.

Ask for Steve Bowsher, he's the president. Lead with Dickson Mounds: the Illinois Capital Development Board handed them a $1,135,000 EMERGENCY award on 2024-07-24 - ref 102-040-011 - to strip and replace about 24,000 square feet of ballasted EPDM at the state museum in Fulton County, plus roughly 700 linear feet of coping tuckpointing. Say: 'the State of Illinois picked you for an emergency million-dollar roof, and there is not one page online a private building owner can find you on.' Back it with 35 years - started September 1990 - IDFPR license 104006217, and 80 permitted projects. The no-website line is real and checkable: designedroofingsystems.com does not resolve at all, and the CIB AGC directory literally prints 'http://NULL' where his website should be. DO NOT mention BBB (Not Rated, not accredited) - no reputation pitch. DO NOT use the corporate secretary's name, sources disagree on Carl vs Joe Anders. DO NOT bring up the museum's ruined artifacts or water damage - that was the failing 1969 roof he was hired to FIX, and framing it as a problem story will land as an insult. Commercial shop - do not ask about houses.

Ask for Tony Arteaga - he owns it. Lead with the parked domain, it is the most concrete thing you have: he owns arteagaconstruction.com and right now typing it lands you on a GoDaddy 'this domain is parked, get this domain' page with ad links on it. Say: 'you already paid for the name and GoDaddy is selling ad space on it.' Then the proof he is worth a real page: on 2025-03-31 he pulled City of Milwaukee permit HVAC-GEN-25-01012 for the Bronzeville Creative Arts & Technology Hub buildout at 616 W North Ave - $1,000,000 valuation, $12,201 permit fee. Forty years in Milwaukee, incorporated 1986, BuildZoom top 10% of 94,017 Wisconsin contractors, union shop, MBE and SBE. DO NOT mention DBE - WisDOT denied their application and it is in the federal appeals database. DO NOT say 'workforce over 100' - that is their marketing copy and ZoomInfo says 20-49; do not put a headcount in his mouth. DO NOT reference Nicholas De Arteaga or WI entity M048090, that is a different company in Fremont. Do not poke the older lapsed concrete license dates.

Ask for Allan Demmer, he owns it. Lead with the licenses, because that is the thing no competitor in Dyersville can copy: they hold THREE Iowa licenses under one roof - EL000506EC electrical (verified active July 2026), 52541-CL plumbing and mechanical, and contractor registration C137743 filed as a corporation - plus TWO masters of record on staff, Michael Betts and Timothy Fitzgerald, alongside Allan. Say: 'you can legally close a job three trades deep and there is nothing online that says so - demmermechanical.com does not even resolve.' The Facebook page IS their website right now: the PHCC of Iowa directory prints their Facebook URL in the website column while other members have real domains. PHCC member, bonded, BuildZoom top 32% of 39,764 Iowa contractors. DO NOT pitch reputation management or mention reviews - they have one Facebook review and BBB has them Not Rated, it will land as an insult. DO NOT ask about company history or a name change - the local paper ran 'New name, same faces at Demmer Mechanical' and we could not read what happened. DO NOT raise the 52541-CL expiration date, it is stale scrape data.

Ask for Henry (Jessica runs the office - likely who answers). Lead with the commercial permit: he pulled BLDC24-0089 at 2018 Waterfront Dr in IOWA CITY - a commercial roof tear-off and replacement, 60 miles from his Clinton shop. Say: 'you're driving to Iowa City for commercial tear-offs and there's nothing online for anyone to find you by.' Back it with Iowa reg C133608 active and 100% recommend across 19 Facebook reviews. Text-friendly: he invites texts to 563-249-8414. DO NOT mention BBB (not accredited / Not Rated), DO NOT call his Facebook dead (last post July 2025 but it's his only asset and it's at 100%), DO NOT mention that ezroofing.com belongs to a Florida company - that lands as 'you lost your name.' Spell it Fernandez, not the BBB's 'Fernanadez.' Do NOT say 53 reviews - unconfirmed.

Dubuque local - same town as Ricky. Lead with volume and the paperwork: 128 permitted projects on file and an ACTIVE USDOT number with 3 drivers, and the only thing a homeowner searching 'furnace repair Dubuque' can land on is a Facebook page. Say: 'you've pulled 128 permits in this town and I couldn't find a website for you anywhere.' Best proof point: a single job at 2459 Kerper Blvd took four 115k-BTU furnaces and four A/C units - that's commercial-scale work with no site to show it on. DO NOT say anything like 'looks like you're growing fast' - permits are actually DOWN 44 to 31 to 28 across 2023-2025. DO NOT assert his Facebook page is gone; it wouldn't load logged-out, so ask rather than tell. Don't credit the company with decades - the LLC formed Dec 2021.

Ask for Brett Seward, President - he's named on both association profiles and handles bids. Lead with the union credential: they're a Bricklayers Local 8 SIGNATORY in the current 2025 trades directory, and they already OWN sewardmasonryinc.com - it's been serving a blank 'Under Construction' page. Say: 'you already bought the domain, it just says Under Construction.' That's the sharpest opener in this batch - he's paid for it and never got a site. Back it with two association memberships (CIB AGC + SIBA) and commercial/institutional scope: masonry, concrete, air barriers, thermal and moisture protection. DO NOT state a number of years in business - SOS says 2017 but the firm reads older. DO NOT mention the Facebook post honouring 'Joann Seward' - tone is unclear and it could be a memorial. Address is 812 Park St, not the 798 Procore lists.

Home-market call. Ask for Sara, she runs the schedule. Lead with the history: Encyclopedia Dubuque traces Dimmer Brothers through four Dubuque addresses since 1971 - Garfield, Jonathan Lane, East 7th, now Davenport Street - and 55 years later there is still nothing to find online. Say: 'you're in the Encyclopedia Dubuque and you still don't come up on Google.' DO NOT mention licences (a second licence type shows inactive) and DO NOT open with reviews - they have zero reviews anywhere and it is their sore spot.

Ask for Mike Tobin, President. THE KEY MOVE: do NOT say 'you don't have a website' - they BOUGHT tobinbrothers.com and never built on it. Say 'you own tobinbrothers.com and it's sitting empty - I already built what belongs on it.' That is flattering instead of accusatory. Back it with 63 years: shop opened 1 January 1963 on NE Perry, AGC and MIMCA member. Alt number (309) 208-6124. DO NOT raise reviews (they have none) and DO NOT claim anything about their licence - IDPH status was never verified.

ASK FOR JENNIFER BUNJES - she is the named principal. Lead with the mismatch: a union shop bonded for public and private jobs up to $500,000, in the Blue Book since 2000 - and the whole company runs off an @mac.com email address with no domain at all. Say 'you're bidding half-million-dollar work off an @mac.com address.' If the main line is dead try (815) 703-5226. DO NOT name Don Bunjes (unconfirmed), DO NOT mention the Rockford Chamber (their listing lapsed), DO NOT lead with the MBE flag (self-reported), and DO NOT guess at their headcount - no source has one.
